properties.name: camel.springboot.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether routes should automatically start when Camel starts.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.brokers
properties.description: URL of the Kafka brokers to use.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.consumers-count
properties.description: The number of consumers that connect to Kafka server.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.auto-commit-enable
properties.description: If true, periodically commit to ZooKeeper the offset of messages already fetched by the consumer.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.allow-manual-commit
properties.description: Whether to allow doing manual commits via KafkaManualCommit.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.break-on-first-error
properties.description: This options controls what happens when a consumer is processing an exchange and it fails.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.max-poll-records
properties.description: The maximum number of records returned in a single call to poll().

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.auto-offset-reset
properties.description: What to do when there is no initial offset in ZooKeeper or if an offset is out of range.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.max-poll-interval-ms
properties.description: The maximum delay between invocations of poll() when using consumer group management.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.key-serializer
properties.description: The serializer class for keys (defaults to the same as for messages if nothing is given).

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.key-deserializer
properties.description: Deserializer class for keys if nothing is given for keys.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.value-deserializer
properties.description: Deserializer class for values if nothing is given for messages.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.request-required-acks
properties.description: The number of acknowledgments the producer requires the leader to have received before considering a request complete.

properties.name: camel.component.kafka.additional-properties
properties.description: Sets additional properties for either kafka consumer or kafka producer in case they can't be set directly on the camel configurations.
